title: 第15章 天才区七十七号第16章 有些离谱的别墅
slug: 巫师让你学知识你杀穿万界
lines: 霍尔顿停下脚步，脸上的懒散一扫而空，取而代之的是肃穆和恭敬。
他上前两步，右手抚胸，微微躬身。
“血骨塔三等巫师学徒霍尔顿·西斯莱，奉灵骨守卫大人之命，护送荆棘帝国最后一名新生入塔。”他顿了顿，从怀里取出一枚骨牌，双手捧着递上前，“此为新生的身份凭证，请大人核查。”
那巨大的蝙蝠头颅垂下目光，金色竖瞳扫过霍尔顿掌心的骨牌。
大约三息后，它缓缓开口：“身份无误。”
霍尔顿暗暗松了口气。
蝙蝠头颅的目光从骨牌上移开，落在伊森身上。
那一瞬间，伊森只觉得被什么恐怖的东西盯上了。
那双金色竖瞳里没有情绪，只有纯粹的、压倒性的审视。
几息后，蝙蝠头颅收回目光。
“小家伙，资质尚可。”它的声音依旧低沉，“进去吧。记住，血骨塔内，规矩森严。犯了错，没人保得了你。”
话音落下，那巨大的头颅开始缓缓消散。
从边缘开始，漆黑的皮肤化作细碎的黑雾，猩红色的纹路黯淡下去，金色竖瞳最后闭合。几个呼吸后，所有雾气彻底融入虚空，拱门恢复了原本的模样。
霍尔顿长出一口气，把骨牌收回怀里。
“走吧。”他重新迈步，穿过拱门。
伊森跟了上去。
跨过拱门的瞬间，伊森只觉得眼前景象骤然一变。
高塔的基座粗壮得需要几十人合抱，塔身表面流转着淡淡的银色纹路；穹顶建筑通体由某种半透明的材质构筑，内部隐约有光芒流动；远处一座巨大的钟楼顶端，悬浮着一团幽绿的火焰，火焰中能看见无数细小的符文在缓慢旋转。
街道上偶尔能看见人影。
有的穿着深色袍服，步履匆匆；有的披着斗篷，兜帽遮住面目；有的赤裸着上身，露出布满纹身的精壮肌肉，肩上扛着某种怪异的器械。他们看见霍尔顿，有的点头示意，有的视若无睹，自顾自地走自己的路。
霍尔顿没有理会这些人，只是带着伊森继续往前走。
穿过几条街道，绕过一座巨大的喷泉，两人来到一片低矮的建筑群前。
这些石屋一字排开，约莫有二三十间，每间都是方方正正的，看着毫不起眼。
“新生报到处。”霍尔顿朝那些石屋扬了扬下巴，转身看向伊森，“跟我来。”
他推开最近一间石屋的门。
屋内空间不大，约莫二十来平米。
正对门口是一张宽大的石桌，桌后坐着一个穿着深灰色袍子的中年男人。
男人身材精瘦，一头灰褐色的短发乱糟糟地支棱着，脸上带着明显的倦意，手里握着一支羽毛笔，正对着一本厚厚的册子写写画画。
听到开门声，男人抬起头，目光扫过两人，最后落在霍尔顿身上。
“霍尔顿？”他挑了挑眉，放下羽毛笔，“怎么，最后一批送来了？”
“嗯。”霍尔顿点点头，侧身让出伊森，“荆棘帝国的，就这一个。”
“就一个？”男人愣了一下，目光在伊森身上转了一圈，“我记得荆棘帝国那边报上来的人数是一百四十多......”
“都死了。”霍尔顿随口答道。
男人沉默了一息，然后点了点头，没有再问什么。
他从桌后站起身，绕过石桌走到伊森面前，伸出右手。
“身份骨牌。”
content_en:
Holden stopped, the laziness on his face was wiped away, replaced by solemnity and respect.
He took two steps forward, put his right hand on his chest, and bowed slightly.
"Holden Sisley, the third-class wizard apprentice of the Blood Bone Tower, was ordered by the Lord of the Bone Guard to escort the last new student of the Empire of Thorns into the tower." He paused, took out a domino from his arms, held it in both hands and handed it forward, "This is the new student's identity certificate, please check it."
The huge bat head lowered its gaze, and its golden vertical pupils scanned the dominoes in Holden's palm.
After about three breaths, it slowly spoke: "The identity is correct."
Holden secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
The bat-skull's gaze moved away from the dominoes and fell on Ethan.
At that moment, Ethan only felt that he was being targeted by something terrifying.
There was no emotion in those golden vertical pupils, only pure and overwhelming scrutiny.
After a few breaths, the bat head looked back.
"Little guy, your qualifications are acceptable." Its voice was still low, "Go in. Remember, there are strict rules in the Blood and Bone Tower. If you make a mistake, no one can protect you."
As the words fell, the huge head began to slowly dissipate.
Starting from the edge, the dark skin turned into fine black mist, the scarlet lines dimmed, and the golden vertical pupils finally closed. After a few breaths, all the mist completely merged into the void, and the arch returned to its original appearance.
Holden took a deep breath and took the dominoes back into his arms.
"Let's go." He took another step and walked through the arch.
Ethan followed.
The moment he crossed the arch, Ethan felt that the scene in front of him suddenly changed.
The base of the tower is so thick that it requires dozens of people to hug it. There are faint silver lines flowing on the surface of the tower; the entire dome building is made of some kind of translucent material, and there is faint light flowing inside; in the distance, there is a group of green flames floating on the top of a huge bell tower, and countless small runes can be seen slowly rotating in the flames.
Occasionally, people can be seen on the street.
Some were wearing dark robes and walking hurriedly; some were wearing cloaks with hoods covering their faces; some were bare-chested, revealing strong muscles covered with tattoos, and carrying some kind of weird equipment on their shoulders. When they saw Holden, some nodded, others turned a blind eye and went their own way.
Holden ignored these people and just continued walking forward with Ethan.
After passing through several streets and bypassing a huge fountain, the two came to a group of low buildings.
These stone houses are lined up in a row, there are about twenty or thirty of them, each one is square and looks inconspicuous.
"Freshman Registration Office." Holden raised his chin towards the stone houses, turned to look at Ethan, "Follow me."
He pushed open the door of the nearest stone house.
The space inside the house is not large, about twenty square meters.
Opposite the door is a large stone table, behind which sits a middle-aged man wearing a dark gray robe.
The man is lean and lean, with short gray-brown hair sticking out messily. He has obvious tiredness on his face. He holds a quill in his hand and is writing and drawing on a thick book.
Hearing the sound of the door opening, the man raised his head, glanced over the two of them, and finally landed on Holden.
"Holden?" He raised his eyebrows and put down his quill, "What, the last batch has been delivered?"
"Yeah." Holden nodded, sideways to let Ethan go, "This is the one from the Empire of Thorns."
"Just one?" The man was stunned for a moment, and his eyes turned around Ethan, "I remember that the number of people reported by the Thorn Empire was more than 140..."
"They're all dead." Holden replied casually.
The man was silent for a moment, then nodded without asking any more questions.
He stood up from behind the table, walked around the stone table and walked to Ethan, extending his right hand.
"Identity dominoes."
